title: A Oath for the Ember
author: Edmund Okonkwo
blurb: Juniper Voss, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
